versions.changelog:
dingtalk-log 1.0.0

- Initial release of the skill for querying DingTalk user logs via the topapi/report/list API.
- Supports filtering logs by template name, employee userId, and time range.
- Implements pagination with cursor and size parameters (up to 20 per page, 180 days max range).
- Requires enterprise internal or third-party enterprise app authorization and access_token handling.
- Detailed response parsing and error handling guidance included.
